ABOUT UNIT

Money is fundamental to how people and businesses operate, but it often sits outside the software they use every day. Unit changes that. Unit is a financial infrastructure platform that enables technology companies to store, move, spend, and lend money inside their product.

Unit processes over $100B in annual transaction volume, serves 2M+ accounts, and handles 11M+ API calls daily for category-defining companies including Wix, Highbeam, Wayflyer and Relay.

Today, leading technology companies use Unit to create smarter money experiences, deepen customer relationships, and unlock new revenue. We’re building the infrastructure that will make financial products a native part of software, and we’re looking for people who want to help shape what comes next.

We’ve raised $160m+ from top investors including Insight Partners and Accel, and 60+ angels. We are proud to be recognized on CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies. https://www.cnbc.com/worlds-top-fintech-companies-2026/

THE ROLE

As a key member of our team, you'll have a significant impact on shaping the direction of the company and product. You will manage Unit features from design to deployment, solve complex issues, and collaborate with different teams.

For the right candidate, this is a rare opportunity to help build an industry-defining company from the ground up.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Implement enterprise-grade backend services which can handle Unit’s scale and use cases.

- Own and develop Unit features end-to-end - from design, through implementation, testing and deployment.

- Solve diverse, complex problems at a large scale distributed microservices environment

- Interact with various teams across Unit and work together to deliver ground breaking features in the fields of Banking, Payments, Cards and Lending.

- Develop solutions for developers, with a strong emphasis on performance and quality.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR?

- 5+ years of backend development experience, in a microservice environment

- Hands-on experience with building, deploying and maintaining testable, scalable systems in a cloud environment

- Good understanding of critical production systems concepts - high availability, reliability, and scalability

- Experience with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)

- Experience with CI/CD

- Production experience with Kubernetes - advantage

- Experience with Scala - advantage

- Passion for Software and Functional Programming - advantage

- Experience with ZIO / Cats / scalaz - advantage

- Experience with DDD, EventSourcing, CQRS - advantage

#LI-Hybrid

LIFE AT UNIT

Working at Unit means helping shape the future of financial technology. We’re a global team that thinks big, moves with purpose, and takes ownership of the work we do. We care deeply about building great products, solving hard problems, and helping our customers succeed.

We value people who are curious, collaborative, and ready to make an impact. At Unit, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, learn alongside talented teammates, and help build what’s next.
